# Maintaining this collection

Read README.md and the relevant skill before changing it. Shared skills provide task methods, not universal project policy or new authorization.

- Keep each skill independently copyable with references, LICENSE and NOTICE.md. Do not link to another checkout, another skill, or maintainer configuration.
- Keep product rules and personal preferences outside shared instructions. Do not assume a package manager, branch model, output language, framework or vendor.
- Use concise Traditional Chinese file-purpose headers and comments for non-obvious implementation decisions. Explain usage before technical details in documentation.
- Update TECHNICAL.md for design changes and record validation limits. Structural checks are not independent behavioral review.
- Use a task branch and reviewable PR; preserve unrelated work. Run README checks and inspect the full diff before committing and pushing. Do not merge, tag or publish without authorization covering that action.

This file governs collection maintenance. It is not installed with individual skills and does not override an adopting repository's instructions.
